goal.en: Place events in time and things in space, and say how often you do something.
goal.ar: أن تحدد الزمان والمكان، وأن تعبّر عن تكرار الأفعال.

head: Preposition
Use with
Example
rows: months, years, seasons, parts of the day
in July, in 2026, in the morning

text.en: Think of it as zooming out: at = a point, on = a day, in = a longer period.
text.ar: تخيّلها تدرجاً من الأضيق إلى الأوسع: at لنقطة زمنية، وon ليوم، وin لمدة أطول.

text.en: “In the morning” but “at night”. This pair is irregular — memorise it.
text.ar: نقول in the morning لكن at night. هذه الحالة شاذة فاحفظها كما هي.

head: Preposition
Meaning
Example
rows: on the table, on the wall
at a point or an event
at the door, at school, at a party

items.en: The keys are on the table.
I am at the bus stop.

text.en: Frequency adverbs go BEFORE the main verb but AFTER “be”: She always arrives early. She is always early.
text.ar: ظرف التكرار يأتي قبل الفعل الرئيسي، لكنه يأتي بعد فعل الكون: She always arrives early وShe is always early.

text.en: “Never” is already negative: say “I never eat meat”, not “I don't never eat meat”.
text.ar: كلمة never منفية في ذاتها، فلا نجمعها مع نفي آخر. نقول I never eat meat.

questions.sentence: I study ___ the morning and work ___ night.

explanation.en: “In the morning” but “at night” — an irregular pair worth memorising.
explanation.ar: نقول in the morning وat night، وهي حالة شاذة تُحفظ.

prompt.en: Match each type of time word with a correct example.
prompt.ar: صِل كل نوع من التعبيرات الزمنية بمثاله الصحيح.

explanation.en: at = point, on = day, in = longer period.
explanation.ar: at لنقطة، وon ليوم، وin لمدة أطول.

questions.sentence: My children are ___ school until three.

explanation.en: “At school” means there for its purpose (studying). “In the school” means physically inside the building.
explanation.ar: at school تعني وجودهم للدراسة، أما in the school فتعني وجودهم داخل المبنى فعلياً.

options: She lives in Jeddah with her family.
He is waiting at the door for you.
The picture is in the wall in my room.
We are at a party in the city centre.

explanation.en: A picture hangs on a surface: on the wall.
explanation.ar: الصورة معلقة على سطح، فنقول on the wall.

questions.answer: The bank is next to the pharmacy

explanation.en: “Next to” is a two-word preposition of place.
explanation.ar: next to حرف جر مركّب يدل على المجاورة.

questions.sentence: He ___ drinks coffee in the evening.

explanation.en: “Never” goes before the main verb and already makes the sentence negative.
explanation.ar: never تسبق الفعل الرئيسي وتجعل الجملة منفية بذاتها.

explanation.en: With “be”, the adverb comes after the verb: She is always late.
explanation.ar: مع فعل الكون يأتي ظرف التكرار بعده: She is always late.

options: I go usually to the gym on Sundays.
I usually go to the gym on Sundays.
Usually I go to the gym on Sundays too loudly.
I go to the gym usually on Sundays.

explanation.en: With a normal verb, the adverb comes just before it: I usually go.
explanation.ar: مع الفعل العادي يسبقه ظرف التكرار مباشرة: I usually go.

prompt.en: Which word means about 40% of the time?
prompt.ar: أي كلمة تعني نحو ٤٠٪ من الوقت؟

explanation.en: always 100% > usually 80% > often 60% > sometimes 40% > rarely 10% > never 0%.
explanation.ar: الترتيب: always ثم usually ثم often ثم sometimes ثم rarely ثم never.

prompt.en: Add “often” in the right place: “I visit my grandmother.”
prompt.ar: أضف often في موضعها الصحيح: I visit my grandmother.

explanation.en: Frequency adverbs sit between the subject and the main verb.
explanation.ar: ظرف التكرار يقع بين الفاعل والفعل الرئيسي.
الساعة تأخذ at، والأيام تأخذ on.

questions.sentence: I met him ___ the airport ___ my way to Dubai.

explanation.en: “At the airport” (a point/place of activity) and the fixed phrase “on my way”.
explanation.ar: نقول at the airport لأنها نقطة نشاط، وon my way تعبير ثابت بمعنى «في طريقي».
